experiment.topic: Hourly trend persistence in BTC-USD across regimes
experiment.hypothesis: A 20-hour trend in BTC-USD price data is more likely to persist into the next 20 hours when the price movement exceeds a 5% threshold in the initial lookback period.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: If, across at least 10 distinct 20-hour periods in BTC-USD price data from 2020 to 2026, a trend continuation signal (based on 20-hour lookback and 5% price threshold) fails to persist in the next 20 hours, then the hypothesis is falsified.
